Episodes.Title: The Tears of Japchae
Episodes.Description: Since Da-jung was diagnosed with cancer, Chang-wook, her husband, has been in charge of cooking. Their son, Jae-ho, is a senior in high school, and he is waiting for the results of his college admission to come out. Chang-wook cooks japchae for his family today.

Episodes.Title: The Miracle of Space Warp, Dombe Noodles
Episodes.Description: Chang-wook makes dombe noodles for Da-jung. Da-jung is having a hard time trying to remember the beach on Jeju Island she went to with Jae-ho and her sister Da-sol about five years ago but refuses to look it up on the internet. Jae-ho asks Da-jung to get him a studio as a present so that he can live alone once he enters college.

Episodes.Title: Do Gulbi!
Episodes.Description: Chang-wook’s students give him a set of gulbi as a year-end present. Jae-ho learns about Da-jung’s illness. Jae-ho doesn’t go to school and ignores Yeo-jin’s texts and phone calls because he’s disturbed by Da-jung’s condition, and Yeo-jin, who knows nothing about it, is upset.

Episodes.Title: Rice Cake Soup on New Year's Day We Long For
Episodes.Description: Finally, the first edition of Hye-young’s new book is out, so Da-jung delivers it to Hye-young herself. Da-jung tells Min-young to think about taking over her publishing house. Chang-wook makes rice cake soup on New Year’s Day.

Episodes.Title: We All Need Some Sweet Consolation
Episodes.Description: Jae-ho feels helpless regarding Da-jung's illness, so he even audits a class at the medical school and looks up home remedies on the internet. Da-jung visits a woodland burial site by herself to see what it looks like. Da-jung tells Chang-wook to sleep in her bed together.

Episodes.Title: Separate Tangsuyuk
Episodes.Description: Chang-wook buys a Chinese wok and knife and learns the special tangsuyuk recipe to make it properly for Da-jung. Yeo-jin is upset because Jae-ho doesn't understand the frustration she feels as a repeater. Da-jung collapses in severe pain and is taken to the ER.

Episodes.Title: What I Couldn't See Yesterday
Episodes.Description: Da-jung is administered to the hospital and not able to eat much food. As Da-jung says she wants to drink mango juice, Chang-wook makes various types of fruit juices for her. But the doctor says her condition is so serious that immediate surgery might not be possible.

Episodes.Title: An Amazing Effect of No-Antibiotic Thinly-Sliced Pork Belly
Episodes.Description: Da-jung refuses to get surgery. But after a week of Chang-wook’s persuasion, Da-jung decides to get surgery. The surgery, which was expected to take longer than three hours, ends just in one and a half hours, making Chang-wook and Jae-ho worried.

Episodes.Title: Feeling Joy Needs Training
Episodes.Description: Da-jung can eat food after the surgery, but she is still in pain as cancer has spread through her body. Chang-wook feels grateful that she can eat at least and tries his best to take care of her. To share the burden, the aunt in Sweden and Da-sol come to Korea, and Chang-wook cooks food to treat his wife’s family. And Da-sol and Hye-young are surprised to see that Chang-wook’s cooking skills have significantly improved.

Episodes.Title: Carpe Diem, Braised Sea Cucumber
Episodes.Description: Da-jung and Chang-wook start to dispose of Da-jung’s stuff as she is about to be admitted to a care center. Meanwhile, Da-jung’s condition gets worse. As she has almost no appetite, Chang-wook tries to develop a new recipe. The day before Da-jung is admitted, Chang-wook politely declines to sell Da-jung’s car as he is not ready to send her away yet.

Episodes.Title: You're the Juice You Make
Episodes.Description: The doctor tells Da-jung she can drink liquids that aren’t water, so Chang-wook makes fruit juice for Da-jung and filters it multiple times to eliminate all fiber. Da-jung compares the bland but tasty juice to Chang-wook and teaches him how to make his favorite kimchi rice.

Episodes.Title: Is This What That Was For?
Episodes.Description: Chang-wook and everyone bids their final farewell to Da-jung and find their way back to their lives without her presence. Chang-wook finds a way to get closure and come to terms with Da-jung’s absence by doing the last homework Da-jung has left him.

Episodes.Title: There's Something Wrong with Being Popular
Episodes.Description: Cha Si Won, a handsome college freshman majoring in Film Studies, has always accepted societies' shallow views on lookism and works hard to maintain his looks and popularity. He meets Hyeong Da Woon, his classmate, who is naturally gifted with everything that Si Won has to strive for.

Episodes.Title: How to Survive as a Hunk
Episodes.Description: Cha Si Won narrates how he was teased for being chubby as a child and ridiculed for having a father who abandoned his family. He develops a sense of resentment towards Da Un for his natural charisma, but to his dismay, gets paired with him for every group activity. After a party, a drunk Cha Si Won blurts out his honest feelings to Da Un.

Episodes.Title: Let Me In
Episodes.Description: Si Won wakes up on Da Un's bed after Da Un decides to take him to his own home as he was intoxicated and unconscious. He leaves embarassed and attempts to avoid him at the University. Da Un, nevertheless, tries his best to get him to talk. Following a half -hearted conversation with him, Si Won accidentally bumps into a painting by Yun Jeong, freshman of his same major. They formally get to know each other. Da Un decides on a date for their joint assignment and Si Won agrees.

Episodes.Title: The Secret That Cannot Be Told
Episodes.Description: Si Won and Da Un decide to visit a book cafe, but they flee the spot after Si Won runs into his father with another woman. He rides a bike to cool himself off, leaving Da Un behind after he falls off his bike. Si Won returns and apologizes for his insensitive behaviour. Da Un clears up any misunderstandings regarding his actions to Si Won. He gives a 'covered kiss' to him, leaving Si Won confused.

Episodes.Title: Before Sunset
Episodes.Description: Da Un follows Si Won to his home and they run into Si Won's mother and sister, who invite Da Un over for dinner. He stays over at his place that night and reveals that it was his birthday. Si Won asks him why he never told anyone, but Da Un insists that he had a great day, requesting the permission to hang out at his home as his birthday gift. The two of them overcome their differences and starts to grow closer. Si Won's scenario is unexpectedly selected as the winner of a contest in which he had insisted that he would not participate, leading him to get labelled as a backstabber by his friends and seniors. Moreover, he comes to know about Da Un's parents' involvment in it.

Episodes.Title: The Worst Day
Episodes.Description: Si Won finds out that his sister had submitted his work. He becomes the subject of rumour and ridicule and a chubby childhood photo of his is circulated around. He asks whether Da Un (whose parents were the owners of the production company that held the contest) had had a hand in making him win. He loses control and snaps at Da Un when he tries to comfort him. He, nevertheless, takes Si Won's bike back home for him. Si Won goes to Da Un's home and has a heart to heart talk with him. He finally speaks out about his insecurities and reveals that he knew that Da Un likes him.

Episodes.Title: An Elegant Lie
Episodes.Description: Yun Jeong and Do Ba Wu find out that Seonghwan Sunbae was the one who spread Si Won's childhood pictures around and warn him against doing it again. Si Won lacks confidence in his scenario, but moves forward and shares it with his classmates. Da Un steps on Seonghwan's phone after he derides Si Won. Yu Jin, Yun Jeong's friend, visits Si Won to apologize as his picture had been initially used by her as a proof to prove that they used to attend the same Elementary School. They part on friendly terms.

Episodes.Title: Wonderful Life
Episodes.Description: Si Won and his classmates start pre-production of the movie. He struggles to find inspiration for his script and Da Un suggests heading to a hotel to clear his head. He takes him to a sea side hotel where he had once gone alone. Si Won opens up about his lack of confidence. He asks Da Un about himself, but when he brushes off his troubles as silly, Si Won advices him against repressing his pain.

Episodes.Title: One Fine Spring Day
Episodes.Description: Si Won and Da Un spent a night at the hotel. The official production of Si Won's movie begins. The first screening of the movie takes place and Da Un's mother, an award winning director, who had provided the funds for Si Won's winning script invites him and Da Un over for lunch. While he goes out for a moment, he overhears her talking to Da Un about how she had selected Si Won's scenario plainly due to Da Un's insistence and that it would never have made it to the screens if it had not been for him.

Episodes.Title: The Time Between Dog and Wolf
Episodes.Description: Si Won is immensely hurt by the fact that Da Un had sat back and let it all happen, pretending to not know anything. He walks away from him. Returning home he finds his mother in tears after she watches his movie on his laptop. She claims that everything she did was for him. Si Won doesn't argue, but tearfully apologizes to her. Yun Jeong and Cha Si Yeong, Si Won's sister, become closer than mere acquaintances. Da Un attempts to apologize for his actions.

Episodes.Title: Blueming
Episodes.Description: Da Un fails to properly convey his emotions. Si Won sends him a message asking whether things between them were over for real. Da Un, distraught, dreams of his family spending time with him, Si Won's parents getting together and Si Won reconciling with him. The next day, he visits Si Won and expresses his sincere apology, but worries whether it's too late. Si Won gives in and forgives him, finally reconciling for real. They once again spend their day at the sea side hotel, learning more about each other.

One night, as he's returning home, Ji Hoon suddenly finds himself running into a man attempting to kidnap a boy who turns out to be none other than Jae Woo. And while Ji Hoon is able to save Jae Woo from his abductor and prepares to send him back home, Jae Woo is just too afraid to go anywhere for the night.

Episodes.Description: When Ji Hoon overhears a conversation between Jae Woo and Jae Woo's childhood self, he begins to think that there is something strange about all of this for which he then seeks Jae Woo to clarify what exactly is going on.

Episodes.Title: Premium Bath Tissue
Episodes.Description: Woo Hyun once had things going for her. During that time, she had won the award for excellence and dreamt of becoming the best home shopping host at UNI. However, Ok Sun gained all the recognition, and slowly, Woo Hyun's career started to take a step back to the point of selling toilet paper. Now, she yearns for her comeback and approaches their rival home shopping network for a job.

Episodes.Title: Broadcast Disaster
Episodes.Description: Mo Ran holds out her hand to Woo Hyun, who is in despair, and offers her help to turn the tables. However, Woo Hyun finds Mo Ran's complete change in attitude suspicious. Meanwhile, comments mocking Woo Hyun's failed attempt in transferring to Gaon Homeshopping surface on the company's anonymous bulletin board. With her mind in a mess, she ends up ruining the show and goes into hiding.

Episodes.Title: The Resemblance
Episodes.Description: Mo Ran senses that Woo Hyun would remind Hyun Wook of his past love, Hae Soo, and sets up a dinner for them to meet. Woo Hyun catches on quickly to the intent of the meeting, becomes humiliated, and leaves. But soon, she appears before him, soaking wet in the rain. Meanwhile, a mysterious shadow behind Ok Sun's perfect image while she helps In Guk campaign begins to show.

Episodes.Title: Woo Hyun’s Return
Episodes.Description: Woo Hyun comes back to sell out show after show in place of Ok Sun during prime-time slots after meeting with Hyun Wook. Mo Ran explains it was the direction the company wanted, but surprisingly, Ok Sun shares what's been on her mind with In Guk. Meanwhile, Mo Ran becomes deep in thought after receiving a message from James, a young international student, and Woo Hyun has a deep conversation with Hyun Wook on a brisk walk at her location shot.

Episodes.Title: A Familiar Scent
Episodes.Description: Ok Sun visits an orphanage with her son, Jung Hyun. As she solicits a confidential request from the orphanage's director, she shows a deadly side to her character. Meanwhile, during the after-party at the location shoot, Sung Woo gets drunk and confronts Mo Ran about the accident she witnessed, and Woo Hyun gets scouted by the rival network that refused her transfer. Later, Woo Hyun approaches Mo Ran with a bold proposal.

Episodes.Title: An Order to Everything
Episodes.Description: Woo Hyun wants her proposal to launch a cosmetic company in her name with her husband, Do Il, as a co-CEO to get underway. However, Mo Ran has other plans and urgently orders Joon Bum to do something that makes him think twice about following it. Meanwhile, Woo Hyun prepares to start her new show with An Na, who Mo Ran planted to keep watch over her.

Episodes.Title: Hidden Intentions
Episodes.Description: Although Mo Ran is furious about Joon Bum going against her direct orders, she unexpectedly leaves Hyuny, the company under Woo Hyun's name, in his hands. Do Il attends Hyuny's launch meeting as the CEO, and he becomes wary of Joon Bum. Meanwhile, Ok Sun plans to have dinner with Mo Ran, In Guk, and Jung Hyun. However, behind her amiable intentions lies something profoundly deep.

Episodes.Title: Hyuny Launches
Episodes.Description: Ok Sun becomes furious after secretly listening to In Guk and Mo Ran's conversation and begins the revenge she has kept inside for over ten years. Meanwhile, Woo Hyun's Hyuny cosmetic line launches. However, the promotional sample causes skin problems on the influencer's face and becomes a disaster. Do Il, who was in charge of the samples, disappears. Without any options left, Woo Hyun asks Mo Ran for her help.

Episodes.Title: Mo Ran Faints
Episodes.Description: Hyun Wook charges at Mo Ran angrily regarding Hae Soo's ring. Making things worse, he sees Woo Hyun on her knees. Before he gets an answer, Mo Ran, who is already in a weak state, collapses. Later, Do Il appears in front of Hyun Wook and confronts him violently. And James shows up in front of a weakened Mo Ran, who takes him to her house. However, everything James does, gets relayed back to Ok Sun.

Episodes.Title: The Worst Day Ever
Episodes.Description: Ok Sun lets In Guk know about her revenge. In Guk is shaken by Ok Sun's fierce demeanour, and Mo Ran speeds up her plans of establishing a subsidiary as soon as she gets wind of Hyun Wook's counterattack. Meanwhile, Woo Hyun finishes up her first show with Gaon but soon finds out Hye Rim betrays her at the hands of Mo Ran and tells everything she's been hiding to Hyun Wook.

Episodes.Title: Woo Hyun Returns
Episodes.Description: Ok Sun violently tells Mo Ran about the past she knew between her and In Guk but gets even angrier when she tells her she never once betrayed her, whom she thought of as a younger sister. Meanwhile, Hyun Wook opens up after hearing Woo Hyun's confession and prepares a way for her to come back to UNI Homeshopping. As Woo Hyun's comeback show turns out to be a success, Mo Ran rushes to see Sin Ae and threatens her with a secret about her past for her shares in the company.

Episodes.Title: Woo Hyun Challenges Sin Ae
Episodes.Description: Hyun Wook, who has now fallen helplessly from knowing how Sin Ae killed Hae Soo, gets comforted by Woo Hyun. Woo Hyun bravely faces Sin Ae, who would do anything to stop anyone after her husband, and challenges her to the fight. She tells Do Il that she wants a divorce and says she loves someone else. Meanwhile, Ok Sun obtains shares in UNI Homeshopping from James and tells Mo Ran about his true identity.

Episodes.Title: Running Out of Time
Episodes.Description: Mo Ran finds out that Jung Hyun is her son and asks In Guk, in uncontrollable confusion, how the adoption came to be. Meanwhile, Ok Sun, who now has a considerable stake in UNI Homeshopping, begins to take control. She scraps Woo Hyun's show and gets Mo Ran suspended. Later, Hyun Wook finds out about Mo Ran's deepest secret as she recovers in the hospital.

Episodes.Title: A Battle For Desires
Episodes.Description: Hyun Wook gives Woo Hyun some time to think after his sudden marriage proposal. Meanwhile, In Guk faced a crisis in his political career due to Ok Sun's disclosure of his affair, and Jung Hyun, who figures out it was Mo Ran from the description in the article, warns her not to hurt his mother, Ok Sun. Later, Woo Hyun figures out Ok Sun's true colours when she sees her about her shows getting cancelled. She also realizes she was just a pawn in Mo Ran and Ok Sun's battle for their desires.

One day, Moo Tae, his old friend, visits him and asks if he could help his little sister, Ga Eul, get back on track. Jegal Gil hesitates due to personal reasons.

Episodes.Title: Jegal Gil The Crazy Guy
Episodes.Description: After getting permanently banned from the Taereung Training Center for doing the unacceptable, Jegal Gil has made a successful career for himself as a mental coach. One day, Moo Tae, his old friend, visits him and asks if he could help his little sister, Ga Eul, get back on track. Jegal Gil hesitates due to personal reasons.

Episodes.Title: She Just Won’t Give Up
Episodes.Description: Even with injuries, Ga Eul has no intention of dropping out of the upcoming race. Gil tries to tell her and make her understand that there is more than just one way to achieve something, but it’s difficult to change one’s long-practiced ways of dealing with hurdles. Eventually, Gil brings Ga Eul to the No Medal Club, where ex-national team athletes with one or more permanent injuries hang out. Ga Eul feels frustrated.

Episodes.Title: A Camel In The Desert
Episodes.Description: Jegal Gil does not agree with Ga Eul’s way of approaching the race. However, Ga Eul sticks to her plan and enters the race. Her plans were well prepared, but it was not good enough to outlast the pain from her injury and the hurdles from Coach Oh. Jegal Gil lets Ga Eul deal with her own defeat, and at the same time, he carries out a plan he’s been building out quietly.

Episodes.Title: The Trail Unmarked on the Map
Episodes.Description: Coach Oh’s assaults on the athletes have become the object of criticism after being exposed by one of the victimized athletes. However, seeing that those who should feel ashamed are not appreciating the gravity of the situation, Jegal Gil looks for a way to punish them and protect those who are most vulnerable.

Episodes.Title: The Black Bird On My Shoulder
Episodes.Description: Lee Moo Kyeol, who has achieved a Grand Slam, is at the center of a doping scandal. Tae Man tries to cover up the scandal with a little extra support from the union head, at the same time, Moo Kyeol claims that he’s clean. However, unlike what he claims, he runs away from the doping test. Meanwhile, Ga Eul no longer wants counselling from Jegal Gil due to a misunderstanding.

Episodes.Title: Crustacean Molting
Episodes.Description: Everyone experiences a stage in life when they are vulnerable and weak, and that’s what Ga Eul and Moo Kyeol are going through. Jegal Gil’s job is to treat these athletes who are unfamiliar with the slump and to help them get out of it without forcing them into treatment. With national team selection just around the corner and the athletes denying the treatment, Jegal Gil must come up with a plan.

Episodes.Title: Right To Fail
Episodes.Description: Ga Eul finally confronts Coach Oh’s physical violence. At the same time, Moo Kyeol also points out the unfairness prevalent in Swimming Union. Meanwhile, Jegal Gil invites the two to No Medal Club. A tip from Moo Tae opens up an opportunity for Jegal Gil to bring Coach Oh down, but he does not realize that everything comes at a cost.

Episodes.Title: Can Hurt Caused By People Be Healed By People?
Episodes.Description: Gil never even thought that Moo Tae was capable of standing on his opposite side, but it happened. What’s worse is the fact that Tae Man even took the evidence that is crucial to banning Coach Oh from coaching. With misfires piling up, Gil loses control of himself and decides that he should step down from the position as a mental coach. Right then, someone knocks on the doors of No Medal Club.

Episodes.Title: The Best Medicine For Your Slump
Episodes.Description: Jegal Gil returns as a mental coach with Seung Ha’s help. Along with Ga Eul and Moo Kyeol, Jegal Gil joins the archery team’s training camp. At the camp, what catches Jegal Gil’s eyes is Shin Ye Ji, the ace on the archery team who is suffering from the symptoms of target panic. Jegal Gil comes up with a special treatment to help her out, but he seems to be crossing the line a little too often.

Episodes.Title: What Do You Really Want?
Episodes.Description: Seung Ha lets Jegal Gil know that she’s worried about Ga Eul’s feelings toward him, but he laughs it off. Meanwhile, Coach Oh Dal Sung is reinstated as a coach with Tae Man’s help and goes right on to do his usual things to his athletes. Knowing that Coach Oh is back, Jegal Gil yet again gets himself involved in the situation as a secret helper. However, it seems like what Ga Eul needs is a chance to make choices on her own.

Episodes.Title: The Jokes Our Emotions Play
Episodes.Description: He may be one of the best mental coaches, but when it comes to love, Gil is nothing but a sore loser. When Ga Eul confesses her feelings for Gil, Gil assumes that her feelings are temporary and fake and suggests that she should see Seung Ha for further mental coaching. Meanwhile, Kang Han Na, the ace gymnast, reveals that she’s suffering from hallucinations. Gil tries to help her, hoping that he won’t be too late this time.

Episodes.Title: Not Later But Now
Episodes.Description: Yeo Woon has to choose between surgery and the Olympics, but the years of effort that she has put in make it hard for her to make the right choice. In order to get Gil out of the way, Tae Man uses Ga Eul to capitalize on Gil’s weakness. Meanwhile, during Taekwondo Regionals, Gil realizes that the referee has been bribed as well as the fact that it’s Tae Man’s doing.

Episodes.Title: The Return Match
Episodes.Description: Gil comes up with a plan to take action against corruption throughout the sport industry with Park Seung Tae at the center of it. Meanwhile, Moo Tae has to choose the side on which he hopes to stand when everything ends. At the same time, Ga Eul figures out what her brother is up to and wants to prevent Gil from getting himself into a sticky situation.

Episodes.Title: Switching Offence and Defence
Episodes.Description: Now that Moo Tae knows what Ga Eul had to go through all alone, he and Gil set the stage for their next move to bring Tae Man and Assemblyman Park down. Ga Eul and Sun A, in the meantime, are on the run from Coach Oh’s inappropriateness. Getting his hands on Assemblyman Park’s ledger leads Gil to unexpected discoveries.

Episodes.Title: Match Point
Episodes.Description: It’s pay back time for Tae Man who has just realized that he’s been exploited by Assemblyman Park. And this time, he teams up with Gil. Unfortunately, crucial pieces of evidence are all gone, and they find themselves stuck at a dead end. At that very moment, Seung Ha steps into the No Medal Club with a silver lining of hope.

Episodes.Title: The Special Moment When You Choose Love
Episodes.Description: Seung Ha watches Gil helplessly getting battered and does what she should’ve done a long time ago. With Seung Ha’s decision to hand over the evidence to the prosecution, Assemblyman Park finds himself with his back against the wall. Meanwhile, Ga Eul also makes sure that her confession gets Coach Oh the punishment he deserves. That makes Gil the only one who hasn’t made the choice yet.

And he also announced that the holiday prize would be replaced with Steve Money. Ashley who can't stand it then plunges into a currency war caused by Monica. Meanwhile, Jay thought about the shaman's prophecy.

Entries.Description: The three friends each have their own story. Since their youth, they were wishing for a life that they thought was perfect for themselves. However, it just turns out that they live exactly the opposite lives they wished for. One who has a perverted husband, one who recently lost her husband, and one who cannot see her husband often. The three women fight alongside each other to overcome their difficulties.

Episodes.Title: The Good, the Bad, the Unlucky
Episodes.Description: The three friends each have their own story. Since their youth, they were wishing for a life that they thought was perfect for themselves. However, it just turns out that they live exactly the opposite lives they wished for. One who has a perverted husband, one who recently lost her husband, and one who cannot see her husband often. The three women fight alongside each other to overcome their difficulties.

Episodes.Title: Is an Affair Considered Love?
Episodes.Description: Ma Ri starts to find evidence that Nak Gu is having an affair. She goes to a lawyer to plan the divorce. Meanwhile, Hee Soo also goes through a problem of her own with her husband. Her long and old dream of having a child becomes nothing because of what her husband has done. Jin A, on the other hand, has no husband issues but is still tormented by the thought of the Ogwang-dong Squirrel.

Episodes.Title: The Bloody Love
Episodes.Description: Ma Ri will not give Nak Gu what he wants. She makes it official that she will never divorce Nak Gu. Hence, Nak Gu has to keep living with Ma Ri while worrying about how she might kill him every day. Meanwhile, Jin A catches a criminal who is suspected to be the Squirrel. As the criminal gets unmasked, Jin A is shocked to see that he is someone she knows.

Episodes.Title: The Red Pill or the Blue Pill?
Episodes.Description: Ma Ri is in search of evidence that Nak Gu was having an affair on the night of a day in April 2021. She digs into a speeding ticket of that day in hopes of finding a photo of both Nak Gu and Go Eun. Nak Gu, on the other hand, goes to a divorce specialist lawyer to win against Ma Ri. He finds and makes as much evidence as possible to make sure the divorce comes through.

Episodes.Title: Dead or Bad
Episodes.Description: Ma Ri finds Nak Gu and Go Eun when the two are on their way to getting married. The aggressive car chase ends up sending Ma Ri and Nak Gu to a hospital. Meanwhile, Woo Bin suddenly appears in front of Jin A. Looking at her dead husband standing right in front of her, Jin A impulsively takes him home and locks him up in a room until she decides what to do with him.

Episodes.Title: Witch, Your Neighbor
Episodes.Description: Ma Ri and Nak Gu head face to face in their legal dispute. They use every evidence they have to get the upper hand. Meanwhile, Woo Bin stays at Jin A's place for a while until he decides what to do. One night, the two catch the Squirrel as Woo Bin clearly remembers how he looks like. Although Jin A has one less thing to worry about, she doesn't see the trouble Woo Bin will bring.

Episodes.Title: You, Don't Cross the Line
Episodes.Description: Ma Ri decides to show no mercy and barges into the wedding hall with Jin A and Hee Soo by her side. Everyone tries to stop Ma Ri, but Ma Ri, in her angry state, cannot be stopped. In the end, Nak Gu makes changes in his plan and takes the bull by the horn as he moves in with Ma Ri. The two being back in the house together only makes the situation worse, and Nak Gu even brings an unwelcome guest into the house.

Episodes.Title: Sleeping with the Enemy and Soo Ji
Episodes.Description: The whole family is gathered as Ma Ri and Nak Gu continue to argue over matters regarding their divorce. To make things worse, Ma Ri and Nak Gu’s mothers meddle in and make the already impossible situation even worse. Meanwhile, Hee Soo and Jin A are also going through life-changing moments of their own, which also don’t seem so rosy.

Episodes.Title: There Is No Going Back
Episodes.Description: Nak Gu lies unconsciously on the floor, and Ma Ri has already left the house. Meanwhile, Ma Ri, Jin A, and Hee Soo are on their way to a place with a blood-soaked body in the trunk. Nak Gu eventually wakes up from unconsciousness and starts looking for Go Eun. However, Go Eun is nowhere to be found.

Episodes.Title: You're All Surrounded
Episodes.Description: Girls and boys end up spending the night in the same villa. Unfortunately, none of the couples have their issues aligned. One thinks that both would be better off without the other, but the other is willing to risk life to stay together. In the midst of it, some things that are meant to be kept as secrets get revealed, forcing them to rely on the last resort.

Episodes.Title: Not So Kind Women
Episodes.Description: Ma Ri’s plan was to lure Nak Gu to the Chulreong Bridge and see how things pan out. However, Nak Gu actually fell for her trap and ended up falling off. The police investigation begins and Ma Ri becomes the main suspect. However, without Nak Gu’s body, the investigation hits a dead end. Meanwhile, the other two girls are also going through their own once-in-a-lifetime moments.

Episodes.Title: It's Not Over...
Episodes.Description: The relief that Ma Ri expected from cutting ties with Nak Gu turns out to be something less fancy, and some sort of sadness takes her over. However, in no time, the situation takes a turn when someone least expected at Nak Gu’s funeral shows up. Meanwhile, Jin A and Hee Soo prepare themselves for the new chapter of their lives.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3

Episodes.Title: Episode 4

Episodes.Title: Episode 5

Episodes.Title: Episode 6

Episodes.Title: Episode 7

Episodes.Title: Episode 8

Episodes.Title: Episode 9

Episodes.Title: Episode 12

Episodes.Title: Not All Neighbors Are Good Neighbors
Episodes.Description: In search of a new beginning, Lee Eun-pyo moves into a new apartment. She finds a note left by a former tenant to beware of Kim Yu-bin's mom.

Episodes.Title: Adults Don't Make Friends Without Motives
Episodes.Description: Eun-pyo grows anxious when she sees her son, Jung Dong-seok, being disruptive in class. Byeon Chun-hui is appointed head of the PTA.

Episodes.Title: That Dawn Before the Day Breaks
Episodes.Description: When Eun-pyo overhears that her son has been blacklisted by the school community, she decides to leave the neighborhood.

Episodes.Title: Entering Green Mothers' Club
Episodes.Description: Eun-pyo tries to get Dong-seok into Yu-bin's group for the Rube Goldberg Competition. Seo Jin-ha's son, Henry Benuel, joins an opposing team.

Episodes.Title: An Ill-Fated Match Made in Heaven
Episodes.Description: At the art exhibit, Eun-pyo encounters someone she was hoping to avoid and Jin-ha meets someone who reminds her of her painful past.

Episodes.Title: A Letter From the Dead
Episodes.Description: As tragedy stirs the community, everyone tries to find out what happened while covering up their own tracks. Eun-pyo discovers a mysterious note.

Episodes.Title: The Scarlet Letter
Episodes.Description: As rumors grow more rampant, the moms are called to attend a group session at school. Jung Jae-ung faces hard truths as his wife's past comes to light.

Episodes.Title: Your Downright Lie
Episodes.Description: Seeing that the case may soon come to a close, Jae-ung moves quickly to find the real cause of death. More gossip bubbles beneath the surface.

Episodes.Title: Towards the Top 0.01%
Episodes.Description: To protect her family and to climb the social ladder, Eun-pyo banks on Dong-seok's abilities. Kim Yeong-mi begins to suspect her husband.

Episodes.Title: Wind From the Tip of a Sword
Episodes.Description: Upon receiving a tip from an informant, Louis Benuel brings in Chun-hui and Lee Man-su for questioning. Dong-seok appears on a TV show for gifted kids.

Episodes.Title: The Sins We Did Not Find Out About
Episodes.Description: Dong-seok sees a child therapist. Chun-hui deals with Yu-bin's unusual behavior. Eun-pyo reaches out to the one person who can help her son feel better.

Episodes.Title: Can Adults Become Friends Without Motives Too?
Episodes.Description: Eun-pyo makes peace with a mom who is on the same boat as her. Chun-hui faces growing financial pressure. Yeong-mi discovers a secret folder.

Episodes.Title: The Two Faces of Truth
Episodes.Description: Eun-pyo turns to Chun-hui with shocking news. When Chun-hui advises her to stay put and be quiet, it only fuels Eun-pyo's drive to expose the truth.

Episodes.Title: Yellow Light
Episodes.Description: Chun-hui gives her husband an ultimatum, but struggles to find a way to support her family alone. Jin-ha's housekeeper entrusts Eun-pyo with a secret.

Episodes.Title: Human Choice
Episodes.Description: While out for drinks, Park Yun-ju witnesses a shady scene. When a message arrives on Jae-ung's phone, Eun-pyo makes an irrevocable decision.

Episodes.Title: The Warm Hand You Extended
Episodes.Description: Brought in for questioning by the police, Chun-hui names who she thinks is the real suspect. Henry makes a devastating confession to his father.

Entries.Title: Woori the Virgin
Entries.Description: Woo Ri contemplates her abstinence pledge and is on the verge of letting go of all her beliefs with Kang Jae. Meanwhile, Raphael returns from the hospital after beating cancer and tells Ma Ri he wants a divorce. To change his mind, she secretly plans to get artificial insemination done with the last of his sperm. However, Woo Ri is at the clinic at the same time and gets it done instead.

Episodes.Title: The Pledge To Abstinence
Episodes.Description: Woo Ri contemplates her abstinence pledge and is on the verge of letting go of all her beliefs with Kang Jae. Meanwhile, Raphael returns from the hospital after beating cancer and tells Ma Ri he wants a divorce. To change his mind, she secretly plans to get artificial insemination done with the last of his sperm. However, Woo Ri is at the clinic at the same time and gets it done instead.

Episodes.Title: A Box Of Apples
Episodes.Description: Woo Ri tells Kang Jae that she's pregnant with someone else's baby, shattering his marriage proposal. Meanwhile, Raphael and Mi Ja find out about the medical mishap. Although Raphael supports Woo Ri, Mi Ja won't accept it and tells the chairman about what happened. Chairman Kim desperately wants a grandchild and approaches Woo Ri with a box of apples.

Episodes.Title: Woo Ri Decides To Have Mallet, The Baby
Episodes.Description: Woo Ri makes up her mind and decides to have Raphael's baby. She tells him about it amidst a murder that happens in the hospital that pleasantly shocks him. However, Woo Ri starts to doubt Raphael after seeing him with other women and reading online articles about him being a playboy. She starts to follow him around to confirm her suspicions.

Episodes.Title: Wild Hormones
Episodes.Description: Raphael finally remembers he met Woo Ri before by the East Sea and starts to think their second encounter is a string of fate. Meanwhile, Woo Ri's oestrogen levels heighten with her pregnancy, causing her to lust for Kang Jae. However, the letter she wrote to him explaining her needs and desires lands in Raphael's email box. She runs to stop him from reading it, but it's too late.

Episodes.Title: I’m Your Father
Episodes.Description: Seoung Il tells Woo Ri that he is her father. Woo Ri gets shocked by the news and becomes angry at Eun Ran for lying to her. She packs her things and leaves the house. Meanwhile, Seoung Il finds out about Woo Ri's pregnancy and then causes a scene at the hospital that gets filmed and posted online, causing public outrage.

Episodes.Title: Kang Jae’s Lie Comes To Light
Episodes.Description: Kang Jae starts to feel left out, seeing Raphael next to Woo Ri all the time. Woo Ri senses this and tries to make it up to him by going on a camping trip with him. But later, she becomes devasted after she learns Kang Jae had lied about not knowing of Ma Ri's affair and how he had covered for her so that it wouldn't alter Woo Ri's mind about giving them the baby once it was born, putting their relationship in turmoil.

Episodes.Title: Woo Ri Faints
Episodes.Description: Woo Ri feels horrible for breaking up with Kang Jae and has trouble eating and sleeping, which doesn't go unnoticed. She even faints. Raphael tries to shower her with good food and rest, but Woo Ri won't accept it openly. Meanwhile, Kang Jae tries to get back together with Woo Ri as he tracks down a suspect that could link him to Chairman Kim.

Episodes.Title: The Virgin Miracle
Episodes.Description: Woo Ri moves on but starts having dreams about Raphael. Raphael also starts to have visions about Woo Ri. However, whenever he tries to tell her how he feels, something gets in the way. Meanwhile, Woo Ri becomes known as the virgin miracle, and Ma Ri uses that to her advantage and sticks a video DJ streamer on her to harass her.

Episodes.Title: Woo Ri And Raphael Start Dating
Episodes.Description: Woo Ri and Raphael tell each other that they have feelings for one another and kiss. Ma Ri, who just finalized the divorce with Raphael, overhears them and becomes frantic. Her mother tells her the only way to separate them is to get rid of the baby. Ma Ri listens to her and meets with Woo Ri. Meanwhile, Eun Ran and her mother go on a double date and find out something unexpected.

Episodes.Title: The Handmade Necklace
Episodes.Description: Someone breaks into Woo Ri's house to look for the necklace Ma Ri had secretly planted on her. As the culprit tries to get away, he injures Woo Ri's grandma, and she gets taken to the hospital unconscious. Meanwhile, Kang Jae receives a gift that leads him to Raphael's safe, and Du Pal gets away from Ma Ri and Mi Ja, causing them to go into hiding.

Episodes.Title: Raphael Stays At Woo Ri’s
Episodes.Description: Kang Jae tries to stop Woo Ri from seeing Raphael, but Woo Ri doesn't believe Raphael has anything to do with Chairman Kim. After warning Raphael, he gets suspended from work for a week. Meanwhile, Raphael stays at Woo Ri's place for a few days and realizes Eun Ran doesn't think he is the right person for Woo Ri.

Episodes.Title: Woo Ri Gets Taken
Episodes.Description: Kang Jae finds evidence in Chairman Kim's room, linking him to the murders. He arrests Chairman Kim, but things start not to add up as Chairman Kim gets abducted. As the chase goes on, Woo Ri gets stuck in the middle and gets taken as well. Kang Jae and Raphael rush to save her.

Episodes.Title: Who’s It Going To Be?
Episodes.Description: Kang Jae and Raphael apologize for what they did to Woo Ri and try to win her back. However, Woo Ri can't decide between Kang Jae and Raphael, driving her nuts. Meanwhile, Ma Ri tells Raphael her true intentions and identity, which leads to Kang Jae arresting Chairman Kim, the drug lord.

Episodes.Title: Ri Woo Is Born
Episodes.Description: Woo Ri is just about to make her decision on who she is going to marry. But out of the blue, she ends up with appendicitis and gets rushed to the hospital. After Woo Ri recovers, she proposes to the one she knows will always be by her side. Meanwhile, Woo Ri's daughter, Ri Woo, comes into this world. And soon after, they celebrate her 100th day as a big happy family.

Entries.Title: Dear X Who Doesn't Love Me
Entries.Description: Hee-soo is desperate for true love. All she can do is just dream about making love with her crush, Gang-wook. Because in reality, he is the popular guy at school who is totally out of her league. Although she wants to confess her love to him, she is afraid that it will only end up embarrassing herself.

Episodes.Title: Nobody Loves Me
Episodes.Description: Hee-soo is desperate for true love. All she can do is just dream about making love with her crush, Gang-wook. Because in reality, he is the popular guy at school who is totally out of her league. Although she wants to confess her love to him, she is afraid that it will only end up embarrassing herself.

Episodes.Title: Mysterious Notebook
Episodes.Description: With the help of the notebook, Gang-wook falls in love with Hee-soo all of a sudden. However, the more Hee-soo spends time with Gang-wook, the more she feels that something is wrong with this notebook magic, but she can’t let herself give up on him. Meanwhile, Si-ho notices that Hee-soo is hiding something.

Episodes.Title: From One Love To Another
Episodes.Description: Gang-wook suddenly becomes aggressive and breaks up with Hee-soo. Shocked by this sudden disaster, Hee-soo finds out that the relationship came from the power of the notebook. She studies how to use it and starts dating anyone she wants just for a month each. Si-ho is worried that she may never find true love.

Episodes.Title: The Winter Beach
Episodes.Description: Si-ho tags along to Hee-soo and Jun-young’s trip. Although he didn’t want to, he cannot stand letting Hee-soo go only with Jun-young and Se-jin. On the trip, Jun-young keeps expressing his love to Hee-soo and Se-jin also confesses her feelings to Si-ho. Despite the love the two get from others, they do not feel that it is the love they want.

Episodes.Title: What a Best Friend Can Do
Episodes.Description: Hee-soo shows Si-ho what her secret notebook can do. She starts going out with Park Jun-young, and he doesn’t ask her to break up with him even after a month. Meanwhile, Hee-soo finds out that Se-jin asked Si-ho out, leaving her feeling all confused.

Episodes.Title: You Deserve Better
Episodes.Description: It turns out Jun-young’s been messing up with Hee-soo and that he’s been talking behind her back. Hee-soo becomes the center of the school’s gossip, and when she’s about to have a panic attack, Si-ho appears in front of her, just like how she did when Si-ho was struggling back in high school.

Episodes.Title: Fireworks
Episodes.Description: Si-ho and Hee-soo are planning to get rid of the notebook. However, they are not able to find it anywhere and just leave it since they were going to discard it anyway. Hee-soo applies for a band to become their lyricist. There, she meets a boy who actually likes her even without the power of the notebook.

Episodes.Title: Something Impossible
Episodes.Description: Hee-soo becomes miserable after thinking that no one would love her if not for the notebook. Hence, she believes that it is taken by Se-jin and that it is her who wrote about the relationship with Do-bin. Surprisingly, Do-bin proves that his love has nothing to do with the notebook. Hee-soo is dumbfounded by this and starts to find hope.

Episodes.Title: The Last Page
Episodes.Description: Hee-soo talks to Do-bin about how she does not deserve to be loved. But he helps her realize that there is someone who always sticks by her side no matter what. Meanwhile, Se-jin suffers more each day because of the notebook. She tries every way possible to get rid of it, but nothing works.

Episodes.Title: To Me Whom I Love
Episodes.Description: As Hee-soo tries to figure out a way to get rid of the notebook, she learns from her father that the notebook is one of her mother’s pregnancy diaries. She then realizes whom she must write in the notebook to end the curse and save Se-jin. Although she makes many guys love her, she did not know that loving herself first is the most important thing.

Entries.Title: Curtain Call
Entries.Description: The Chair of Nakwon Hotel, Ja Geum-sun, yearns to meet her family left behind long ago in North Korea. There is tension in her South Korean family: her grandson Se-jun tries to sell the hotel, while granddaughter Se-yeon fights to stop her brother. Meanwhile, someone seeks out Jae-heon, an unknown theater actor, for an unusual task.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: The Chair of Nakwon Hotel, Ja Geum-sun, yearns to meet her family left behind long ago in North Korea. There is tension in her South Korean family: her grandson Se-jun tries to sell the hotel, while granddaughter Se-yeon fights to stop her brother. Meanwhile, someone seeks out Jae-heon, an unknown theater actor, for an unusual task.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: As Se-yeon tries to stop the disposal of hotel, her ex-fiancé, Dong-je, appears. Meanwhile, after accepting Sangcheol’s proposal, Jae-heon considers who to recruit to help carry out his mission. The curtain finally rises on a grand play, created and performed for one particular person.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Geum-sun greets the arriving couple, Jae-heon and Yoonhee, with a face full of excitement and touched emotion. However, each member of the household has their own opinions and feelings about the newcomers, especially since Jae-heon will receive a stake in the hotel. Se-yeon takes Jae-heon on a tour of Seoul, hoping to influence him to her side.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Jae-heon and Yoonhee try their best to maintain their cover as Geum-sun’s grandson and his wife. They put their heart and soul into acting as Ri Moon-seong and Jang Jinsook, trying to bring joy to Geum-sun while avoiding the suspicions of her family and others who could reveal their true identities.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Se-yeon persuades Geum-sun to have Jae-heon work at the hotel. Since he has plenty of experience working in part-time jobs, Jae-heon quickly adapts and shows his talents. But not everyone welcomes Jae-heon, and they are trying to make things difficult for him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Se-jun accelerates his plan to sell the hotel. Se-yeon meets her ex-fiancé Dong-je, who owns a 4% stake and will become the casting vote for the disposal of hotel Nakwon. Meanwhile, Jae-heon, Yoon-hee, Se-yeon, and Dong-je have an unexpected dinner together.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Geum-sun holds her own farewell party, inviting the special people in her life. Se-jun, Se-gyu, and Se-yeon greet their guests at the entrance of the banquet hall. As the time of the party draws near, Jae-heon and Yoon-hee encounter some unexpected personnel working at the event.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Geum-sun hides the fact that her health is getting worse. Jae-heon and Yoon-hee begin feel guilty about their deception, as Geum-sun is treating them with love and kindness. In the meantime, Tae-joo learns the secret of Ri Moon-seong that Sang-cheol has been hiding.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Se-yeon hesitates about whether to tell Geum-sun about Jae-heon’s secret. Jae-heon feels embarrassed at Se-yeon’s awkward behavior towards him. Meanwhile, Tae-joo and the real Ri Moon-seong arrive in South Korea.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Jae-heon notices that Se-yeon and Se-jun have somewhat changed their attitude towards him. He realizes that his identity and plans has been discovered, and becomes distraught. Meanwhile, Se-jun bonds with Moon-seong and puts pressure on Se-yeon.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: When Se-yeon learns about the plan, she decides to become part of it and joins Jae-heon, Yoon-hee, and Sang-cheol. The four cooperate to stop Se-jun’s plan of unveiling the real ‘Ri Moon-seong’ and to allow a happy ending to the performance.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: When Se-yeon learns about the plan, she decides to become part of it and joins Jae-heon, Yoon-hee, and Sang-cheol. The four cooperate to stop Se-jun’s plan of unveiling the real ‘Ri Moon-seong’ and to allow a happy ending to the performance.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Ri Moon-seong is back. Sang-cheol informs three people that Se-jun is plotting for Geum-sun and Moon-seong to meet. To counter Se-jun’s plan and discover Moon-seong’s intentions, Se-yeon assigns a task to Jae-heon and Yoon-hee.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Jae-heon, Yoon-hee, and Sang-cheol reveal the truth to the family, except for Geum-sun. Finally, the fake grandson leaves and the real one enters, but there is an awkward silence. At that time, Jae-heon prepares another scene for Geum-sun.

Episodes.Title: Luice's Biggest Ordeal

Episodes.Title: So Rin’s Hidden Past

Episodes.Title: Enough Is Enough
Episodes.Description: Si Woo can't stand seeing So Rin living with Luice, so he takes Luice to his place. But Luice declines the offer and goes back to So Rin's place. Meanwhile, a friend from high school visits So Rin and asks if she's interested in joining an idol competition show.

Episodes.Title: A Get-away

A still photographer joins them, and he steals every female staff member’s heart. Both Si Woo and Luice get jealous when he hits on So Rin.

Episodes.Title: A Long Overdue Confession
Episodes.Description: Si Woo panics after finding out that So Rin knows he likes her. He realizes it’s finally time to pluck up his courage and confess his feelings. Meanwhile, Masha asks So Rin if she’s interested in becoming an idol trainee.

Episodes.Title: Back To Being A Trainee

Episodes.Title: Making Peace

He ends up in the hospital with an injury, and the police investigate who was behind the attack. Meanwhile, the members of N and S get together to discuss the future of the group, and So Rin gets to appear on a TV show.

Episodes.Title: Stars Don’t Disappear
Episodes.Description: Ji Hyeong gets confused after he got an offer as the chief editor of Youngtoon. Man Chul tells him to think about himself first. Ma Eum feels sad to hear the rumour as he was her first mentor. Finally, at the team dinner gathering, Ji Hyeong announces his decision on whether he’ll leave or stay.

Episodes.Title: You're A Flower Too
Episodes.Description: Jun Yeong mistakenly thinks that Ji Hyeong and Man Chul are responsible for his sister’s death. He can’t decide whether to betray the team even further and hand over the materials he got from Young Bae to Director Heo. Ji Hyeong shares what happened to Jun Yeong’s sister to Ma Eum, and she finally understands Jun Yeong’s past actions.

Episodes.Title: Mustering Up Their Courage
Episodes.Description: The managing director of Neon gives the webtoon team one last chance to prove their place in the company. Chief Editor Jang gathers the whole team to encourage them to work with him for their final shot. However, Ma Eum witnesses Jun Yeong secretly meeting Director Heo.

Episodes.Title: Don’t Let Your Bad Luck Catch Up With You
Episodes.Description: Jun Yeong tells Ma Eum why he’s been seeing Director Heo separately. Ma Eum meets Director Shin with Dae Lyug to discuss the drama adaptation of “Weapon Feeb”. However, Dae Lyug runs away during the meeting out of trauma that Director Shin triggered. Meanwhile, Gang Nam shares big news with Ma Eum and Ji Hyeong.

Episodes.Title: Stars Shine For You
Episodes.Description: Dae Lyug’s mother visits Neon, hoping to get his address. She ends up following Ma Eum to Dae Lyug’s place, and he panics at the sight of her. Someone uploads a malicious post about Dae Lyug, saying he molested a woman. Now Ma Eum has to deal with Dae Lyug’s mother and find evidence to prove the post wrong in order to help Dae Lyug with his artist’s block.

Episodes.Title: Go for It Head-on, and Let It Break You
Episodes.Description: Dae Lyug successfully submits and uploads the next episode of “Weapon Feeb,” thanks to everyone’s help. The long-awaited board meeting is held, keeping everyone on the Webtoon Team on their toes. Mr. Baek decides to take a long break and get an operation on his back. The webtoon team and Dae Lyug visit him after the operation, only to hear bad news.

Episodes.Title: Take A Step Forward
Episodes.Description: Ma Eum and Producer Kwon choose the same webtoon artist again, and they must come up with proposals to win the artist’s heart. Jun Yeong thinks of the ways to confess his feelings for Ma Eum. Meanwhile, Man Chul receives an offer from Managing Director Yoon that he cannot resist.

Entries.Title: The Empire Of Law
Entries.Description: The hotshot professor at Korea’s number one university is even on his way to the presidency. Geun Woo plays the perfect husband in front of his family but is actually being unfaithful to his wife Hye Ryul. Meanwhile, Hye Ryul goes up against Jusung although it is run by her in-laws. This case goes viral and grabbed the whole nation’s attention.

Episodes.Title: The Professor
Episodes.Description: The hotshot professor at Korea’s number one university is even on his way to the presidency. Geun Woo plays the perfect husband in front of his family but is actually being unfaithful to his wife Hye Ryul. Meanwhile, Hye Ryul goes up against Jusung although it is run by her in-laws. This case goes viral and grabbed the whole nation’s attention.

Episodes.Title: Christmas Fund
Episodes.Description: The Christmas Fund that many people talk about is suspected as the cause of a person’s death. Certain that it is a murder case, Gu Won digs deeper despite the danger. Hye Ryul gains enough power to compete with her husband for the presidency. Nobody is able to figure out what the competent couple has in mind.

Episodes.Title: The Affair
Episodes.Description: Gwang Jeon finds out about Geun Woo’s affair, but does not use it against him yet. However, she is not the only one who knows about it. Meanwhile, crucial information regarding Hye Ryul’s investigation gets leaked to the press. Although it causes some difficulties, it does not stop her from doing what she thinks is right.

Episodes.Title: The Breakup
Episodes.Description: Nan Hee asks Hye Ryul to buy her a drink after she helps her with the computer. As Geun Woo also tags along, the air becomes tense. Meanwhile, Hye Ryul decides to help the police with their investigation on the Christmas Fund. Just before their great arrest, something goes sideways and their only chance disappears.

Episodes.Title: Their Favourite Restaurant
Episodes.Description: After watching Ji Joon Ki’s interrogation, Hye Ryul asks Geun Woo out to dinner. At the couple’s favourite restaurant, Hye Ryul tries to comfort her husband by showing how much she appreciates him putting up with her mother. Just then, Kang Baek shows up with his friends and suggests that they join Hye Ryul and Geun Woo. Geun Woo’s face stiffens.

Episodes.Title: The Unwelcomed Guest
Episodes.Description: To sabotage Nan Hee’s plan, Hye Ryul asks Kang Baek to bring Ji Yi home for dinner to discuss their marriage. The whole family gathers and prepares a feast to welcome their future family member, Ji Yi, only to be surprised by who turns up at the door. When Ji Yi finds out about the dinner, she asks her dad to stop the investigation on Jusung.

Episodes.Title: Fair And Square
Episodes.Description: News reports on Chairman Ji’s letter and his claims give Hye Ryul and everyone involved in this case a headache. But what torments Hye Ryul the most is what Nan Hee tries to do with her son. When Hye Ryul gets a text from Kang Baek that he might not come home, she starts to fret frantically. Meanwhile, Geun Woo meets with Nan Hee to try and stop her from using Kang Baek for her revenge.

Episodes.Title: The Mock Trial Competition
Episodes.Description: At the mock trial competition, the students argue over a case that’s made up based on the actual case from 20 years ago. During the trial, Nan Hee becomes overly zealous, which piques Gun Do’s interest. Meanwhile, Hye Ryul and Geun Woo’s kiss in the car made the headlines, successfully diverting the public’s attention from the investigation.

Episodes.Title: The Body In The Lake
Episodes.Description: Gun Do invites Nan Hee over to his office to offer her compensation in order to silence her. But it is not enough. Nan Hee threatens Gun Do that something else will be on the news if Ham & Lee doesn’t apologize publicly for what they did to her father. The next day, a woman’s body is found floating on the lake at Minguk University, which shocks many. Eun Mi assumes the informant she was supposed to meet the night before is the victim and wants to help with the investigation.

Episodes.Title: You All Wished She Was Dead
Episodes.Description: The body is confirmed to be Nan Hee, but it is strange that those who should be the most shocked are calm about this. The detectives try to find clues, but it seems that the culprit has been pretty thorough. Meanwhile, those who were close to or around Nan Hee when she was alive started to become suspicious of one another. While Hye Ryul is extremely anxious about Kang Baek, Geun Woo receives an anonymous letter.

Episodes.Title: Protect Your Son
Episodes.Description: Hye Ryul demands that Geun Woo tell her what he knows about Nan Hee’s plan. While Geun Woo feigns ignorance, Hye Ryul also finds out that her mother knew about Geun Woo’s affair with Nan Hee all along. Meanwhile, Ji Yi declares that she’ll marry Kang Baek even though the public suspect Kang Baek as the killer.

Episodes.Title: Into A Fiery Pit
Episodes.Description: Gwang Jeon tells Geun Woo to make it look like Gu Ryeong is the killer. Knowing she’d go to any lengths to protect her grandson, Geun Woo can’t dare to tell her that he’s being blackmailed. Meanwhile, Hye Ryul pushes forward with her investigation of Jusung rather harshly, causing Moo Ryul to come and provoke Hye Ryul.

Episodes.Title: Kang Baek’s Love
Episodes.Description: Kang Baek has been feeling guilty and suppressed about his true love because of his family and their belief. But his friends all knew about his secret love and wanted to protect him. Meanwhile, thanks to Geun Woo’s help, Gu Ryeong comes off the suspect list. When Hye Ryul hears of this, she gets furious and heads to Geun Woo’s office.

Episodes.Title: Kang Baek’s Confession
Episodes.Description: Although Kang Baek was with someone who could confirm his alibi on the night of the incident, he chooses to remain silent and be questioned by the police. Unaware of this, the whole family becomes anxious and worried about Kang Baek. Before taking Kang Baek to the police, Geun Woo takes him to his mother’s grave, where the two have an honest talk.

Episodes.Title: The Suspicions
Episodes.Description: The whole family is crushed by Kang Baek’s death except for Min Heon. Ae Hun, who cannot stand to spend another second with the monster, musters up her courage and comes to a decision. Meanwhile, Hye Ryul visits the lake where Nan Hee’s body was found, thinking about the conversation they had before she died.

Episodes.Title: The Lousy Truth
Episodes.Description: After watching what was in Nan Hee’s flash drive, Hye Ryul makes up her mind and resumes the investigation on Jusung. Nan Hee’s murder case also gets re-investigated, and it seems the true culprit is indicted. But what really happened on the day Nan Hee died?

Entries.Title: Bad Prosecutor
Entries.Description: A murder case, like no other, stumbles onto Jin Jung's desk. As he starts to investigate it, he finds something peculiar about it. Defying all boundaries as a prosecutor, he pushes forward with the case. However, public outrage and pressure from the higher-ups bring it to an abrupt stop.

Episodes.Title: Jin Jung Gets A Murder Case
Episodes.Description: A murder case, like no other, stumbles onto Jin Jung's desk. As he starts to investigate it, he finds something peculiar about it. Defying all boundaries as a prosecutor, he pushes forward with the case. However, public outrage and pressure from the higher-ups bring it to an abrupt stop.

Episodes.Title: Jin Jung Joins the Civil Affairs Division
Episodes.Description: Jin Jung gets demoted to the Civil Affairs Division, also known as the garbage disposal office, where he meets Park Jae-kyung, a prosecutor who is as bad as Jin Jung back in his days. While Jin Jung deals with the civil complaint cases, he finds a lead in the Seocho-dong murder case. He joins forces with Shin Ah-ra to take on the man behind it all.

Episodes.Title: Jin Jung Spoils The Party
Episodes.Description: Jin Jung doesn't let up and pursues Deputy Chief Prosecutor Lee in the murder case. He goes to extremes and discloses evidence at Deputy Chief Prosecutor's inauguration ceremony, halting his promotion and making him the prime suspect in the murder. However, Jin Jung needs more solid proof and goes after it in the only way he knows how to get things done.

Episodes.Title: The New District Head Prosecutor
Episodes.Description: The death of Deputy Chief Prosecutor Lee Jang-won has Jin Jung stunned. All evidence points to his death as a homicide, but he's the only one who thinks that. Ditching all duties at the Civil Affairs Division, Jin Jung looks for hard evidence that could overturn Chief Prosecutor Lee's death as suicide.

Episodes.Title: Jin Jung Gets Arrested
Episodes.Description: Kim Tae-ho becomes the new head district prosecutor. The first thing he does is arrest Prosecutor Jin for the murder of Deputy Chief Lee. However, it's a little difficult for them to keep him detained. Jin Jung runs out as a fugitive and tries to clear his name.

Episodes.Title: Jin Jung Tracks Prosecutor Oh
Episodes.Description: Ah-ra discovers Jin Jung wounded and rushes him to Jae-kyung's house for help. Luckily, Jin Jung recovers without needing to go to the hospital. Jin Jung and his team focus on Prosecutor Oh for leads, while Ah-ra finds something in the client list that raises concern.

Episodes.Title: The Medical Examiner’s Testimony
Episodes.Description: Jin Jung has District Head Prosecutor Kim Tae-ho right where he wants him and gets the upper hand. However, to make sure he has everything to prove it in court, Jin Jung goes after the medical examiner who fabricated the autopsy report. Meanwhile, District Head Kim knows Jin Jung's plan and orders Prosecutor Oh to stop it from happening.

Episodes.Title: Jin Jung Arrests Kim Tae-ho
Episodes.Description: Jin Jung puts District Head Prosecutor Kim Tae-ho behind bars. However, he still doesn't know who is behind it all. He goes after Tae Hyung-wook, the chief secretary at Law Firm Kangsan, who he thinks killed Deputy Chief Lee. Meanwhile, Prosecutor Oh looks for help from Seo Hyun-kyu.

Episodes.Title: Jin Jung Gets A Lead
Episodes.Description: Jin Jung arrests Tae Hyung-wook, but she won't talk. Meanwhile, Prosecutor Oh joins Seo Hyun-kyu and gets sent to keep her mouth shut as her lawyer. Jin Jung thinks everything happening now stems from the murder of Park Ye-young and begins to focus on Kim Hyo-jun, the deliveryman who confessed to the murder.

Episodes.Title: One Last Chance
Episodes.Description: Jin Jung learns about the past from Jae-kyung and realizes Seo Hyun-kyu had something to do with his father's death. Although Jae-kyung urges Jin Jung to let go of the case, Jin Jung vows to put Seo Hyun-kyu away for good. Meanwhile, Jin Jung remembers the MP3 player was his father's and attempts to unlock the files.

Episodes.Title: Seo Hyun-kyu’s Archive
Episodes.Description: Park Jae-kyung's death destroys Jin Jung. He knows Seo Hyun-kyu was behind Park Jae-kyung's death and goes after him. After finding evidence linking Seo Hyun-kyu to the murder, Jin Jung visits Kim Tae-ho for help. Help that will put Seo Hyun-kyu away for good.

Episodes.Title: Final Episode
Episodes.Description: With the help of Oh Do-hwan, Jin Jung gets the evidence he needs and puts Seo Hyun-kyu on the stand. However, as Jin Jung attacks him with questions, Seo Hyun-kyu isn't worried. Meanwhile, Jin Jung brings in a witness that shocks everyone, including Seo Hyun-kyu.

Episodes.Title: Let’s Begin
Episodes.Description: Jiwoo signs up for the "Marriage and Family" class, where students are paired in male-female duos. However, due to the surplus of male students, he is partnered with Roa, an older male student. Assigned a dating task, the two head to a vending machine to spend their budget wisely—when suddenly, Yuna appears…

Episodes.Title: Can't Leave Her Alone
Episodes.Description: Yuna, traumatized by a stalker, develops a fear of men. Jiwoo volunteers to walk her home daily, despite Roa's advice to let the police handle it. Jiwoo insists on helping, but on his way home, he's attacked. Roa grows concerned when Jiwoo becomes unreachable…

Episodes.Title: Right-Hand Man
Episodes.Description: Roa breaks his arm protecting Jiwoo and demands Jiwoo become his "right hand." At Roa’s home, Jiwoo ends up washing dishes and even Roa’s hair. Meanwhile, Roa’s housemate Namjoon, who secretly has feelings for Roa, calls Jiwoo out…

Episodes.Title: Rumors
Episodes.Description: Rumors spread that Jiwoo and Roa are dating after a mysterious post appears on the school forum. Overwhelmed, Jiwoo avoids campus. Yuna asks Roa about Jiwoo, but he accuses her of being selfish. Meanwhile, Roa visits Jiwoo’s house in the rain…

Episodes.Title: The Confession
Episodes.Description: Roa, suspecting someone they know posted the rumor, begins investigating with Yuna’s help. They find the culprit and peace returns. Then, Yuna privately confesses to Jiwoo that she has feelings for him…

Episodes.Title: Goodbye, My Love
Episodes.Description: Jiwoo tells Roa about Yuna’s confession. Unexpectedly, Roa congratulates him. Jiwoo confesses his own feelings to Roa, who apologizes for misleading him and disappears. Unable to forget Roa, Jiwoo turns to Namjoon to find his whereabouts…

Episodes.Title: Chasing That Person
Episodes.Description: Hyun has been searching for Kim An since enrolling in university, though they’re at the same school, he can't find him. Meanwhile, Minwoo begins avoiding his childhood friend Mal. One day, An finally visits assistant lecturer Sungmin to request a locker…

Episodes.Title: Unspeakable Truths
Episodes.Description: Hyun sneaks into An’s “Marriage and Family” class. Expecting a happy reunion, he’s surprised when An acts cold and pushes him away. Meanwhile, Mal spends time at the café where Minwoo works, unaware of what’s troubling his friend.

Episodes.Title: One-Sided Feelings
Episodes.Description: To help Minwoo, Mal harasses the café manager who bullies him. Meanwhile, Hyun asks Sungmin about An’s past. Seeing them talk, Ju-hyuk—who likes Sungmin—makes a move…

Episodes.Title: Shared Time
Episodes.Description: Minwoo tells Hyun that Mal moved in with him. Ju-hyuk tries to get Sungmin’s attention by bringing up embarrassing stories. Hyun, meanwhile, partners with An for a shared hobby assignment.

Episodes.Title: Just Friends?
Episodes.Description: The next assignment is to introduce a friend. An claims he has none, but becomes tense when Hyun says he met one. Hyun invites him to lunch, but their closeness draws stares in the cafeteria.

Episodes.Title: Disappointment
Episodes.Description: While Hyun introduces Minwoo and Mal to An, Minwoo’s girlfriend, Sara, shows up. Mal gets upset and lashes out at Minwoo. Just then, Lee Si-woo appears and declares he has a deep relationship with An…

Episodes.Title: Mixed Feelings
Episodes.Description: An misses class, worrying Hyun. Mal visits Hyun for advice about Minwoo. Hyun tells him to think deeply, prompting Mal to comically try all the internet’s “thinking methods.” Meanwhile, Ju-hyuk enjoys flirting with Sungmin.

Episodes.Title: Next Step
Episodes.Description: An ends things with Si-woo and leaves the building looking dejected. Hyun walks him home and helps clean his ransacked room. Sungmin, meanwhile, finds something shocking while searching behind the building…

Episodes.Title: Forms of Love
Episodes.Description: An wakes up in Hyun’s room and hugs him from behind while Hyun prepares breakfast. Mal and Minwoo enjoy a peaceful lunch in the park. But Sungmin is distressed, unsure of Ju-hyuk’s true feelings.

Episodes.Title: A Sparkling Moment
Episodes.Description: After winning a game competition, Mal invites everyone on a glamping trip. As they laugh and play, Hyun feels awkward seeing everyone openly affectionate. He pulls An aside to kiss him…
