Episodes.Title: Episode 26
Episodes.Description: Soo Yeon is absolutely certain that Yu Ra has somehow managed to get her hands on Soo Yeon’s design. However, Soo Yeon is having trouble proving her innocence and is also on the edge of getting fired from the company. Now that she has lost everything, Soo Yeon must prove that the design was actually hers at all costs.

Episodes.Title: Episode 27
Episodes.Description: Soo Yeon is able to get her hands on a piece of evidence that proves her innocence. However, Yu Ra doesn’t admit that she has copied Soo Yeon’s work even after seeing the photo. Soo Yeon gets reinstated as a senior manager on another team, and she now has to compete with Yu Ra to prove who’s better. Meanwhile, Soo Yeon looks deeper into finding the truth behind her dad’s accident.

Episodes.Title: Episode 28
Episodes.Description: Dong Ha starts to worry and becomes concerned about the attacks Soo Yeon has to face by the SA Group's family. He even takes her out to buy a new dress because Jin A ruined the outfit she was wearing. Meanwhile, Yu Ra leaves Seo Jun, who had come to tour the company, all by himself.

Episodes.Title: Episode 29
Episodes.Description: Rumors of Dong Ha being Soo Yeon's sponsor go around SA Group, and everyone shuns Soo Yeon and gives her a hard time. Jin A hears about the rumor and becomes infuriated. She plans to teach Soo Yeon a lesson and heads to confront her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 30
Episodes.Description: Yu Ra becomes jealous after seeing Soo Yeon and Jin Woo together and plans something of her own. Jin Woo denies having lingering feelings for Soo Yeon, but he questions if she really cheated on him. Meanwhile, Dong Ha learns that the post on the company's bulletin board came from the design team.

Episodes.Title: Episode 31
Episodes.Description: Soo Yeon’s carefully planned strategy publicly exposes Jin A’s true character, and the entire group faces a crisis because of it. Meanwhile, Hwa Yeong focuses on finding the person who is behind the recent happenings. At the same time, Soo Yeon swears that she will never let anyone mistreat her moving forward.

Episodes.Title: Episode 32
Episodes.Description: Seeing Soo Yeon leaning her head over Dong Ha’s shoulders was too shocking for Jin Woo to the point where he confused Yu Ra with Soo Yeon. Meanwhile, Soo Yeon learns that Seo Jun is sick, but there is nothing she can do for him. Sensing that something is seriously wrong, she decides to just visit Seo Jun even though she’s not allowed to.

Episodes.Title: Episode 33
Episodes.Description: Sun Tae lets Soo Yeon take Seo Jun home so that she can care for him. Soo Yeon takes Seo Jun to see a neuropsychiatrist and learns about all the suffering he has been going through. Meanwhile, Sun Tae tells Hwa Yeong that he wants a divorce.

Episodes.Title: Episode 34
Episodes.Description: Jin A posts that she is self-reflecting by serving homeless people food. However, Mi Sook and Dae Chul get word that she is putting on a show and decide to expose the truth. Meanwhile, Young Ji sees Dae Chul and begins to fall for his handsome looks.

Episodes.Title: Episode 35
Episodes.Description: Soo Yeon helps Dong Ha prepare for the top 100 global leaders interview, while Yu Ra dresses Jin Woo in the finest suit for the same interview. Meanwhile, Soo Yeon finds something suspicious about Yu Ra and Yu Ra's friend who came from abroad.

Episodes.Title: Episode 36
Episodes.Description: A stranger takes Soo Yeon hostage with a knife to her throat. Fortunately, Dong Ha is able to safely rescue her without seriously getting injured. However, Soo Yeon later gets accused of hiring a man to stage a hostage situation. Meanwhile, Yu Ra receives a message from an unknown sender, and she is not happy about it.

Episodes.Title: Episode 37
Episodes.Description: Soo Yeon’s little scheme exposes a little secret about Yu Ra’s college degree. But the news does not sway either Hwa Yeong or Yu Ra. Meanwhile, Dong Ha is worried that Yu Ra’s actions may backfire on her. Meanwhile, Yu Ra thinks there is something suspicious about her housemaid, Young Ji.

Episodes.Title: Episode 38
Episodes.Description: Yu Ra eventually finds out how Young Ji is related to Soo Yeon. Knowing that she can not afford to pay penalties for breach of the confidential agreement, Young Ji keeps the fact that she got caught by Yu Ra a secret from Soo Yeon. Meanwhile, Dong Ha is worried that Soo Yeon might misinterpret his relationship with Jin A.

Episodes.Title: Episode 39
Episodes.Description: The audit team investigates Soo Yeon for selling new material patents. Hwa Yeong tries to fire her, but instead, she gets put on a leave of absence with Dong Ha's help. Meanwhile, Dong Ha finds new information as he tries to clear Soo Yeon's name.

Episodes.Title: Episode 40
Episodes.Description: Soo Yeon takes Jin Woo to Hye Kyung's house, using Seo Jun as an excuse. However, Dong Ha, who witnesses Soo Yeon and Jin Woo leaving the office together, gets bothered by it. Meanwhile, Yu Ra freaks out when she sees the contents of a parcel with no return address.

Episodes.Title: Episode 41
Episodes.Description: Dong Ha hears about Mi Sook and Soo Yeon’s trip to Hwa Yeong’s house and is extremely worried. Meanwhile, Soo Yeon waits for an opportunity to find what she came for, but something goes horribly wrong. Yu Ra gets a threatening phone call from a restricted caller, but she has no intentions of backing down.

Episodes.Title: Episode 42
Episodes.Description: Yu Ra demands an explanation as she sticks a photo of Jin Woo and Soo Yeon together in Jin Woo’s face. This only makes Jin Woo angrier, and now Yu Ra is the one who has to do the explaining. Meanwhile, Soo Yeon wants Jin Woo to agree to a new custody arrangement for Seo Jun’s sake.

Episodes.Title: Episode 43
Episodes.Description: Hwa Yeong lets herself into Jin Woo’s office and finds out that Soo Yeon is after her son’s custody. Soo Yeon’s plan to get Seo Jun back fails, and she takes a step back for the moment. Meanwhile, Mi Sook invites people over in return for the recent dinner invitation. However, things go south for Jin Woo when Yu Ra sees him and Soo Yeon standing a bit too close to each other.

Episodes.Title: Episode 44
Episodes.Description: Clues that Yu Ra has a past that Hwa Yeong does not know about appear here and there. However, Yu Ra's fake parents make a big mistake by talking about Yu Ra out in a public place. At the meeting for the development of the new brand, Hwa Yeong witnesses evidence that Yu Ra's parents might be fake.

Episodes.Title: Episode 45
Episodes.Description: Hwa Yeong's house gets turned upside down. With Yu Ra's fake parents on their knees, Yu Ra tells Hwa Yeong she's pregnant with Jin Woo's child, and Jin Woo tells Hwa Yeong he wants to divorce Yu Ra. Meanwhile, Mi Sook, who knows what happened at Hwa Yeong's, asks Soo Yeon if she will get back together with Jin Woo.

Episodes.Title: Episode 46
Episodes.Description: Jin Woo is furious at Hwa Yeong for wrongfully accusing Soo Yeon of having an affair and wants to undo his divorce. Meanwhile, Soo Yeon looks for an opportunity to acquire more shares of SA Group, and that’s when she learns about Director Ma. Soo Yeon takes a risk of getting something on him, but Dong Ha finds it too dangerous for her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 47
Episodes.Description: Although Soo Yeon does feel safe and protected around Dong Ha, she doesn’t respond to Dong Ha’s love confession right away. Meanwhile, Dong Ha learns about the whereabouts of the person whom Soo Yeon has been looking for and delivers the message to Soo Yeon. Soo Yeon immediately starts looking for him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 48
Episodes.Description: Soo Yeon learns the truth behind the fabrication of her dad’s autopsy result after convincing the doctor to share all the details about the autopsy. Soo Yeon barges into Hwa Yeong’s house and loses her temper. Meanwhile, Soo Yeon comes across one of Mi Sook’s shoes with a familiar brand on it and tells Mi Sook how it is related to her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 49
Episodes.Description: SA Group faces humiliation for swapping the materials used in their products. They come under fire by the media and their customers, and their simple written apology won't do. Meanwhile, Mi Sook stirs the pot and tells Hwa Yeong she might withdraw her investment in the company.

Episodes.Title: Episode 50
Episodes.Description: Jin Woo starts to lose his trust in Hwa Yeong after Yu Ra's miscarriage. He blames her for what happened to Soo Yeon as well. Meanwhile, Hye Kyung runs into Yu Ra coincidentally. She remembers Yu Ra from somewhere but can't quite remember.

Episodes.Title: Episode 51
Episodes.Description: Soo Yeon loses her temper after finding out about what Yu Ra did to Hye Kyung before her cancer surgery. However, Yu Ra does not admit to doing any of the things that she is being accused of. Meanwhile, Soo Yeon is at the hospital looking for evidence to prove that Yu Ra’s miscarriage was a fake.

Episodes.Title: Episode 52
Episodes.Description: With Soo Yeon’s evidence, Hwa Yeong and Jin Woo discover that Yu Ra was never pregnant. Even with all her lies exposed, Yu Ra doesn’t seem concerned at all and continues on being her normal self. Meanwhile, Hye Kyung and Sun Tae are on a date at an exhibition, and standing behind them is Hwa Yeong.

Episodes.Title: Episode 53
Episodes.Description: Hwa Yeong does not expect to run into Sun Tae at the exhibition, especially with a woman by his side. As soon as she gets out of the gallery, she makes sure Sun Tae is followed wherever he goes. Meanwhile, Soo Yeon and Yu Ra are competing for SA Group’s new brand, and Hwa Yeong is confused about the unforeseen result.

Episodes.Title: Episode 54
Episodes.Description: The police show up in front of Soo Yeon and arrest her for kidnapping her own son. As she is not able to think straight, Dong Ha helps her find out what is going on. Meanwhile, Jin A finally finds out that Mi Sook is Dong Ha's mother. She wants to let her mother know about this, but Mi Sook made sure to keep this a secret.

Episodes.Title: Episode 55
Episodes.Description: After learning illegal funding occurred, Dong Ha tells Hwa Yeong that Bareun Partners will withdraw their investment in SA Group. That puts Hwa Yeong in a dire situation, and she scrambles to find a way to preempt a disaster. Meanwhile, Jin Woo hands Yu Ra divorce papers.

Episodes.Title: Episode 56
Episodes.Description: Hwa Yeong has no choice but to keep Yu Ra by her side after finding out about the voice recording that Yu Ra has on her. Meanwhile, Soo Yeon gets a clear sense that Hwa Yeong knows something about her dad’s death. Not being able to get Hwa Yeong to talk, Soo Yeon instead demands that Jin Woo show some sincerity if he wants to get back with her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 57
Episodes.Description: Hwa Yeong and Yu Ra get furious at Jin Woo for embarrassing them in front of the reporter and ruining the interview. However, Jin Woo moves out of the house to get back together with Soo Yeon after throwing a fit at Hwa Yeong. Soo Yeon has no choice but to let him stay with her. Meanwhile, Soo Yeon receives an unexpected phone call about her late father.

Episodes.Title: Episode 58
Episodes.Description: As Soo Yeon rushes out of the office after getting a phone call from a stranger, Dae Chul lets Dong Ha know that she received a tip-off. Dong Ha notices something is fishy about it and goes right after her. Meanwhile, Hwa Yeong no longer needs Yu Ra and wants her to split up with Jin Woo. However, Yu Ra does not give up easily and threatens her back.

Episodes.Title: Episode 59
Episodes.Description: Dong Ha and Soo Yeon reveal each other's feelings while Jin Woo waits at her house for her to return home. When she does, he clings to her. However, she pushes him away again. Meanwhile, Hwa Yeong notices that one of her most-prized jewelry is missing.

Episodes.Title: Episode 60
Episodes.Description: Mi Sook pretends to be drunk and gets in Hwa Yeong's face as Kang In Han, sending shivers down her spine. The act stays with Hwa Yeong, and she starts to dig for a connection between the two. Meanwhile, Hwa Yeong finds out Jin Woo is helping Hye Kyung at her restaurant.

Episodes.Title: Episode 61
Episodes.Description: Soo Yeon is certain that Hwa Yeong is the one who caused her father’s death, and she threatens her to confess. However, Hwa Yeong has no intention of admitting to anything that Soo Yeon says and calls Soo Yeon the crazy one. Meanwhile, Dong Ha wants to tell Soo Yeon everything about his mother.

Episodes.Title: Episode 62
Episodes.Description: The fact that Dong Ha and Soo Yeon are in a relationship annoys Mi Sook. On top of that, she is certain that she will never accept Soo Yeon as her daughter-in-law and demands that Soo Yeon stay focused on revenge. Meanwhile, Sun Tae is watching Hye Kyung’s store while she’s gone for a while and runs into someone unexpected, which surprises both parties.

Episodes.Title: Episode 63
Episodes.Description: Soo Yeon finds out that Sun Tae was the artist who gave Hye Kyung the painting and the man her mom has been seeing. Although Soo Yeon tells Sun Tae to leave her mother alone, she doesn't let Hye Kyung know who he is. Meanwhile, Jin A doesn't stop asking Mi Sook for Dong Ha, which Mi Sook thinks could come in handy.

Episodes.Title: Episode 64
Episodes.Description: Mi Sook introduces Dong Ha as her son to Hwa Yeong, shocking Hwa Yeong. Dong Ha can't grasp why his mother would do that and becomes angry. Meanwhile, Jin A tells Soo Yeon that her mother officially met Dong Ha's mother for lunch with their marriage in mind.

Episodes.Title: Episode 65
Episodes.Description: Soo Yeon furiously grabs Yu Ra by her throat and demands to know why she killed her father. Yu Ra still denies it. However, with evidence in Soo Yeon's hands, Yu Ra needs a way out. She approaches Young Ji for help one more time.

Episodes.Title: Episode 66
Episodes.Description: Soo Yeon is certain that it was either Hwa Yeong or Yu Ra who was responsible for her father’s death. She realizes that she could devise a little scheme with the flash drive to find out which one of the two is lying. Meanwhile, Yu Ra gladly agrees to sign the divorce papers, but Hwa Yeong suspects that Yu Ra must be up to no good.

Episodes.Title: Episode 67
Episodes.Description: Soo Yeon looks into the case of a steep increase in the sales of the design team, and she stumbles upon an irregularity in the sales report. Meanwhile, Mi Sook continues to struggle to end the relationship between Soo Yeon and Dong Ha, but dealing with her son and his issues seems to be more difficult than anything that she has ever done.

Episodes.Title: Episode 68
Episodes.Description: Hwa Yeong tries to get Jin A to forget Dong Ha by setting her up on a date, but Jin A only wants to be with Dong Ha. Meanwhile, Mi Sook has Soo Yeon and Dong Ha come over for dinner, but she also invites someone else that shocks them. Later, Yu Ra uses Jin A to get in the way of Soo Yeon and Dong Ha by telling her of a possible marriage proposal.

Episodes.Title: Episode 69
Episodes.Description: Soo Yeon gets taken to the police station for questioning regarding Jin A's fall. Although she tried to stop her from falling down the stairs, the security footage doesn't show it clearly. Meanwhile, Hye Kyung tries to help Soo Yeon and asks Mi Sook if she could introduce her to a lawyer.

Episodes.Title: Episode 70
Episodes.Description: As word of Jin A's accident goes around, people start to think Soo Yeon truly pushed her. Jin A puts Dong Ha on the spot and tells him she will only let Soo Yeon go if he marries her. Meanwhile, Mi Sook visits Jin A in the hospital and tells her to forget about Dong Ha.

Episodes.Title: Episode 71
Episodes.Description: Hwa Yeong is done holding back her anger and blames Hye Kyung for her soon-to-be realized divorce life. She even slaps Hye Kyung in the face. Later, Hye Kyung finds out how Sun Tae is related to her family. Meanwhile, Soo Yeon gets a request for her custom wedding shoes, but she has no idea who has made the request.

Episodes.Title: Episode 72
Episodes.Description: Dong Ha has one thing and only one thing on his mind, which is to protect Soo Yeon from all harm. It may cost him his happiness, but he is willing to sacrifice it all for Soo Yeon’s happiness. Meanwhile, Soo Yeon digs deeper into the fake purchases of the newly launched design team’s products.

Episodes.Title: Episode 73
Episodes.Description: Soo Yeon eventually accepts that she has ended things with Dong Ha and lets Hye Kyung know that she broke up with him. Meanwhile, Dong Ha feels obligated to marry Jin A, but things get more difficult for him when Soo Yeon finds out about his wedding. At the same time, Sun Tae questions Dong Ha if his love for Jin A is genuine.

Episodes.Title: Episode 74
Episodes.Description: Jin A shows everyone at the wedding ceremony that she can walk. Dong Ha is utterly shocked and doubts it was a miracle. Later, he finds out that Mi Sook knew all along and leaves the house furiously. Meanwhile, Hwa Yeong gets a warning letter regarding the company's default on a contract and calls Yu Ra to her office.

Episodes.Title: Episode 75
Episodes.Description: Hwa Yeong tells Dong Ha that marriage is also part of business and that he should go and talk to Jin A. Meanwhile, Yu Ra gives Mi Sook property to sell in return for help behind Hwa Yeong's back. Later, a body gets found in a reservoir, shocking Yu Ra.

Episodes.Title: Episode 76
Episodes.Description: Young Ji decides to tell Hye Kyung and Soo Yeon about her pregnancy and her plans to raise the kid alone. At the office, Soo Yeon stumbles upon a suspicious conversation between Yu Ra and a stranger, and she thinks it’s worth finding out who the stranger is. Meanwhile, a picture sent by an unknown sender upsets Jin A, and she’s already on her way to SA Group.

Episodes.Title: Episode 77
Episodes.Description: Jin A can’t seem to control her obsession with Dong Ha, and it eventually forces her to make unforgivable mistakes. Meanwhile, Yu Ra finds herself cornered and feels threatened after receiving a package from an unknown sender. Assuming that it was Soo Yeon who sent the unpleasant surprise, Yu Ra does what she does best to sound Soo Yeon out.

Episodes.Title: Episode 78
Episodes.Description: Soo Yeon thinks that locking Yu Ra up in a holding cell will finally reveal all her wrongdoings, but she isn’t so sure anymore when she hears a ridiculous thing about her dad. Meanwhile, Hwa Yeong can’t believe that she allowed Yu Ra to take advantage of her all this time and feels frustrated that she can’t kick her out of the house.

Episodes.Title: Episode 79
Episodes.Description: Yu Ra shows Hwa Yeong the video and demands a large sum of money. Soo Yeon asks around regarding Moran Footwear's former employees to learn more about her father's past. However, Hwa Yeong gets word of it and confronts her about it. Meanwhile, Dae Chul asks Young Ji to marry him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 80
Episodes.Description: Hwa Yeong sees Soo Yeon and Dong Ha together and becomes engulfed with rage. She can't control her anger and slaps him across the face. Later, Mi Sook finds out the painting Hwa Yeong gave her was a fake and takes it back to her. Meanwhile, Dae Chul introduces Young Ji to Mi Sook as his girlfriend.

Episodes.Title: Episode 81
Episodes.Description: Hwa Yeong and Soo Yeon find out that Yu Ra is actually Park Sang Do’s daughter, with her real name being Park Eun Ji. Hwa Yeong then accidentally says something she shouldn’t have without knowing Yu Ra is eavesdropping. Meanwhile, Jin A figures out why the key ring on Dong Ha’s briefcase means so much to him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 82
Episodes.Description: Soo Yeon is in shock after witnessing Yu Ra’s car accident right when it happened. Yu Ra is immediately sent to the hospital, but her condition doesn’t look too good. Meanwhile, Hwa Yeong acts as if she has lost everything after hearing the news regarding the accident, but she’s more curious to know the whereabouts of Yu Ra’s necklace.

Episodes.Title: Episode 83
Episodes.Description: Jin A blames Soo Yeon for Dong Ha’s cold attitude toward her and decides to make Soo Yeon quit. When Soo Yeon rejects her request, she comes up with a hilarious idea to deepen her relationship with Dong Ha. Meanwhile, Jin Woo offers a way to cut Jin A out of Soo Yeon’s life, and Soo Yeon accepts it for everyone’s good.

Episodes.Title: Episode 84
Episodes.Description: Mi Sook witnesses Hwa Yeong slapping Dong Ha across the face and becomes furious. Mi Sook realizes she needs to get Dong Ha out of this misery and decides to let Jin A and him move into her place. Meanwhile, Jin Woo takes Soo Yeon to his house to greet his parents.

Episodes.Title: Episode 85
Episodes.Description: Soo Yeon is shocked when she sees a video of Mr. Kim taking the respirator off her father. However, Soo Yeon knows Hwa Yeong gave the order and is the one responsible. Meanwhile, Jin A asks Mi Sook to give back the shares in the company after she fails to sleep with Dong Ha.

Episodes.Title: Episode 86
Episodes.Description: Hwa Yeong does what she does best and persuades one of her closest errand boys to take the blame. However, Soo Yeon is a few steps ahead of Hwa Yeong and gears up for the final battle. Meanwhile, Jin A’s abnormal obsession with Dong Ha continues, and she even starts following him around.

Episodes.Title: Episode 87
Episodes.Description: Hwa Yeong’s atrocious acts have been exposed through Soo Yeon’s personal live broadcast, and this time, it seems unlikely that Hwa Yeong will get away with it. Meanwhile, Dong Ha is sickened by Jin A’s possessiveness over him when he finds out about her despicable behavior. However, the fact that she got caught only worsened her symptoms.

Episodes.Title: Episode 88
Episodes.Description: Not being able to grasp the situation regarding Yu Ra, Hwa Yeong flounders. However, now that she knows that Yu Ra is alive and that Soo Yeon may well be aware of Yu Ra’s condition, she believes that she now has the upper hand. Meanwhile, Dong Ha carefully continues on with his plans to take over SA Group and waits for the right timing.

Episodes.Title: Episode 89
Episodes.Description: Tae Hoon shows up at Soo Yeon's house and seeks refuge. He tells her everything he knows about the past. Meanwhile, Soo Yeon does a second live-streaming show and reveals how the attack on Hwa Yeong was all staged.

Episodes.Title: Episode 90
Episodes.Description: Soo Yeon finds it strange Hwa Yeong hasn't made a move after learning Yu Ra was still alive. However, Soo Yeon triggers her and gets met by her at Yu Ra's hospital bedside. Meanwhile, Jin A tries to charm her way back into Mi Sook's house.

Episodes.Title: Episode 91
Episodes.Description: Realizing what Hwa Yeong has done to his medication all this time, Sun Tae leaves her. Meanwhile, Soo Yeon panics when she finds out about Seo Jun’s disappearance. It was later revealed that it was all Jin A’s doing, and it eventually led Dong Ha to make up his mind to go through a divorce. When Jin A hears about Dong Ha’s decision, she plans something wicked.

Episodes.Title: Episode 92
Episodes.Description: Jin A’s obsession with Dong Ha almost results in his death, but Mi Sook is still not sure if she should let Dong Ha get divorced. Meanwhile, even after the incident, Jin A’s obsession with Dong Ha continues, and this time, she threatens Mi Sook that she would tell Hwa Yeong everything about her little deal with Mi Sook if she were to demand a divorce.

Episodes.Title: Episode 93
Episodes.Description: Soo Yeon eventually finds out about the whereabouts of Hwa Yeong’s second set of books, but it seems nearly impossible to secure it without letting Hwa Yeong know. However, Ms. Lee suggests that she might have an idea. Dae Chul and Soo Yeon arrive at Hwa Yeong’s storage room, and they run into someone unexpected.

Episodes.Title: Episode 94
Episodes.Description: SA Group's emergency stockholders' meeting commences with Chairman Cha Hwa Yeong's neck on the line. Hwa Yeong can't believe it when she finds out that Mi Sook is the chairman of Bareun Partners. Meanwhile, Soo Yeon also takes part in the meeting.

Episodes.Title: Episode 96
Episodes.Description: Dong Ha’s next step after successfully taking over SA Group is to start his life all over again from the start. In doing so, he asks Dae Chul to find someone suitable for his position. Meanwhile, Soo Yeon makes a visit to the hospital after hearing the news about Yu Ra’s condition, not knowing what unexpected twist lies ahead.

Episodes.Title: Episode 97
Episodes.Description: Jin A’s obsession with Dong Ha eventually puts him in a critical condition, and Dong Ha hovers between life and death. As soon as she hears about the accident, Mi Sook regrets everything that she made Dong Ha go through. Meanwhile, Hwa Yeong’s trickery drives Yu Ra to lurk around outside Mi Sook’s store.

Episodes.Title: Episode 98
Episodes.Description: Mi Sook has completely lost it and tries to kill herself and take Hwa Yeong with her. Jin A’s symptoms are getting worse, and Sun Tae and Jin Woo agree that they should put her in a facility before it’s too late, even if Hwa Yeong thinks otherwise. Meanwhile, Soo Yeon comes up with a concrete idea to make Hwa Yeong pay for all her wrongdoings.

Episodes.Title: Episode 99
Episodes.Description: Soo Yeon's plan works, and Hwa Yeong's confession gets broadcast live for everyone to hear. Meanwhile, Jin Woo asks Dong Ha for a favor, and Yu Ra suddenly appears in front of Soo Yeon and leaves her with an unsettling feeling.

Entries.Title: The Killer's Shopping List
Entries.Description: Daesung Mart develops into the great MS Mart thanks to Myung Sook’s bravery and Dae Sung’s smartness. Although Dae Sung continuously fails the civil service exam and is about to get dumped by A Hee, his love for his mother’s supermarket does not change. He determines to work there as a cashier, but runs into a case that changes his life as an employee of MS Mart.

Episodes.Title: The Beginning of MS Mart
Episodes.Description: Daesung Mart develops into the great MS Mart thanks to Myung Sook’s bravery and Dae Sung’s smartness. Although Dae Sung continuously fails the civil service exam and is about to get dumped by A Hee, his love for his mother’s supermarket does not change. He determines to work there as a cashier, but runs into a case that changes his life as an employee of MS Mart.

Episodes.Title: The Murder Weapon
Episodes.Description: The police begin investigating the body that Dae Sung and Nunchucks Grandpa found. However, Dae Sung becomes nosy again and starts digging into this by himself. His way of investigation is looking into the shopping list of the victim. With the clues that he obtains from there, he notices a suspicious person within the neighborhood.

Episodes.Title: Five Dollars
Episodes.Description: People now know that Nunchucks Grandpa is the notorious five-dollar bill counterfeiter. Although some evidence show that Five Dollars is the murderer, it is not enough to prove his guilt. Dae Sung is upset that the counterfeiter might be set free. However, he witnesses someone else at the murder scene who definitely seems suspicious.

Episodes.Title: Dae Sung in Trouble
Episodes.Description: Five Dollars eventually becomes free from being a suspect. However, the police now suspect Dae Sung. To clear his name, A Hee, Dae Sung, and Myung Sook investigate everyone in the neighborhood. Currently, although their biggest suspect is Fish, Products also seems to be very busy right after the murders occurred. With every possibility in mind, the supermarket investigation begins.

Episodes.Title: A Suspect Within the Supermarket
Episodes.Description: Five Dollars finds and takes what Yul hid in her secret place. But the chairwoman finds the two and saves Yul from the criminal. As many people now think Five Dollars is not the killer, new suspicions lead to someone within the supermarket. Seeing how Veggie seems to be the new target, Meat becomes the number one suspect. Although Dae Sung does not want to believe so, Meat must be investigated.

Episodes.Title: Suspect Meat
Episodes.Description: The chairwoman miraculously survives the fall. Although she is in horrible shape and in a coma, she provides a clue to Products. Meanwhile, Veggie is still going through a hard time. Even though there is no clear evidence, everyone strongly believes that Meat is the one harassing her. However, new events occur and bring up new information regarding the murder cases.

Episodes.Title: Yul’s Secret
Episodes.Description: As Products has been acting suspiciously, Dae Sung and Myung Sook tail her to see if she is the killer. However, Products is not the only suspicious one. Although it is clear that Yul is being abused by her father, she denies help. Dae Sung tries to think why Yul is denying help and confidently says that Dae Sung is not the murderer. This allows him to come up with another lead.

Episodes.Title: The Hero
Episodes.Description: Now that Cheon Kyu stabbed the detective, it is certain that he is the murderer. He then flees with Yul where no one can find them. However, Yul comes up with a clever idea to give a clue to Dae Sung. Without any help from the police force, the employees of MS Mart rush over to save Yul from her father. The hostage situation is dangerous, but everyone risks their lives for Yul.

Entries.Title: Never Give Up
Entries.Description: Looking for the right time to break bad news to his wife, Gu Pil-su suggests a family hotel staycation. Jung Suk pitches his startup to a big investor.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Looking for the right time to break bad news to his wife, Gu Pil-su suggests a family hotel staycation. Jung Suk pitches his startup to a big investor.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Pil-su hears eerie rumors about the house he just moved into. Suk loses everything overnight. Gu Jun-pyo asks his dad to send him to New Zealand.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Pil-su investigates the mansion's haunting secrets and finds his suspicions confirmed the deeper he probes. Nam Seong-mi bonds with the new housemate.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Teaming up to find a person in 24 hours, Pil-su chooses to stake out while Suk uses his app, witnessing its effectiveness firsthand.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Pil-su stresses over losing customers, and Seong-mi gets unexpected news. Suk and Oh Seul-gi go running, only to get tangled up in someone’s affair.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Pil-su sets off again to help Man-geum locate a debtor. Jun-pyo is mighty distracted, and Suk visits the Golden Cupid to find Seul-gi in a bind.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: The search for Lee Hak-jin moves forward. Seul-gi grows frustrated with Golden Cupid's success. Man-geum refuses treatment for a terminal illness.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Pil-su takes Seong-mi out to a celebratory meal, while thoughts of another man fills her head. Residents of the mansion prepare a surprise for Man-geum.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Seul-gi has an unexpected proposition for Suk — and an opportunity. But Pil-su's idea doesn't interest Suk. And Jun-pyo gets deeper into hip-hop.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Pil-su’s photo on Neighbor 24 sparks a new trend. A classmate rats out Jun-pyo. Seong-mi and Hwang Eun-ho's bond deepens.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Seong-mi drops by Montana’s studio to see Jun-pyo. Suk enters the interview round. Pil-su goes through the phone’s contacts in search of leads.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: At Golden Cupid, Lee Min-jae suppresses a potential scandal. Pil-su invites Seong-mi’s college friends over for dinner.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Neighbor 24 introduces a new feature. Pil-su doesn’t have the heart to tell Suk the truth about his mother. Seul-gi faces a family emergency.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Seong-mi welcomes Man-geum home, while Suk maintains his distance. The company behind Neighbor 24 presents the final pitch to investors.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Trouble brews at Golden Cupid. Pil-su’s act of kindness brings an unexpected surprise. Competition results are announced.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Pil-su faces another eviction. Jun-pyo’s performance goes viral. Man-geum opens her home and makes friends in the neighborhood.

Entries.Title: Happy Ending Romance
Entries.Description: A promising young writer, Jung Woo is made to immediately disappear from the publishing industry upon accusing an established writer on accounts of corruption. Amidst his darkest times, Jung Woo ends up finding solace in the arms of Jung Hyun, his closest friend, who decides to support him through his lowest point. Three years later, a young man by the name of Tae Young suddenly appears in search of Jung Woo.

Episodes.Title: A man stays within a man
Episodes.Description: A promising young writer, Jung Woo is made to immediately disappear from the publishing industry upon accusing an established writer on accounts of corruption. Amidst his darkest times, Jung Woo ends up finding solace in the arms of Jung Hyun, his closest friend, who decides to support him through his lowest point. Three years later, a young man by the name of Tae Young suddenly appears in search of Jung Woo.

Episodes.Title: No regrets
Episodes.Description: As Tae Young and Jung Woo cross each other's paths, Tae Young reveals his true intent of wanting to bring Jung Woo back to the literary world, an offer Jung Woo outrightly denies. Meanwhile, Jung Hyun can't help but feel flustered upon hearing of the exchange between Jung Woo and Tae Young.

Episodes.Title: The Happiness That I Want
Episodes.Description: Tae Young suggests that Jung Woo and Jung Hyun become co-authors, will the two writers agree to this plan?

Episodes.Title: The two of us walking in opposite directions
Episodes.Description: A deeply shaken Jung Woo finds an assistant to help him out. At the same time, Jung Hyun also thinks of a way to help out Jung Woo.

Episodes.Title: The End of the Long Wait
Episodes.Description: Jung Woo decides to publish a book under his own name, so Tae Young invites Jung Woo to move into his home and use it as an office.

Episodes.Title: Us Back Then
Episodes.Description: Tae Young begins to help Jung Woo in writing as an assistant, but Jung Hyun still doesn't give up on making things right with Jung Woo.

Episodes.Title: The Reason Why It Has to Be You
Episodes.Description: Seeing that Jung Woo is about to start a new life, Jung Hyun decides to reveal a long-kept secret.

Episodes.Title: Happy Ending Romance
Episodes.Description: Jung Hyun and Tae Young try their best to figure out a way of getting Jung Woo back into the publishing industry, does their plan succeed by the end?

Entries.Title: Stock Struck
Entries.Description: I, Yoo Mi-seo, lived a hard life. I became a beggar overnight! Turns out everyone else was doing stocks except me? I started stocks with the feeling of grasping at straws. Just in time, I hear my friend's sweet stock information, "Keep it to yourself."

Episodes.Title: The Water in Han River is Still Cold
Episodes.Description: I, Yoo Mi-seo, lived a hard life. I became a beggar overnight! Turns out everyone else was doing stocks except me? I started stocks with the feeling of grasping at straws. Just in time, I hear my friend's sweet stock information, "Keep it to yourself."

Episodes.Title: Why We Became Ants
Episodes.Description: My life, is it delisted? Nope! It's not over until it's over! "Hey, you can be a super ant." Join an anonymous stock expert study and meet people who have become ants on the stockboard for various reasons. Who are these super ants that will come to save them?

Episodes.Title: Stocks of Interests are Not Far Away
Episodes.Description: Study members who saw stocks easily and got hit by Ye-jun. Studying is the only way to survive! They turn on their eyes and look for the items they're interested in. Strangely, Haeng-ja and Jin-bae bump into a case. Who will be the winner of the return on the stock of interest?

Episodes.Title: Debt, Sweat, & Tears
Episodes.Description: While she had an eye for sports, Mi-seo felt the limitations of seed money. She can't get any cheap money till the next day. She decided to do "debt" with the heart of the beast, and ended up heading to the reading room. Seon-woo, who noticed, follows Mi-seo, and recalls the memories he wanted to forget there.

Episodes.Title: American Dream in the Corner of the Room
